exposure: Maternal melatonin treatment during the last third of gestation
cohort: Ninety-three single-lambing, undernourished ewes and their lambs were included in the study, with ewes either receiving a melatonin implant or serving as controls.
finding: Melatonin treatment during the last third of ewe pregnancy slightly enhanced the hip surface temperature of lambs at birth but did not influence lamb birthweight, rectal temperature, or ewe-lamb interaction behaviour after birth.
